data.name: Chakradev
data.gender_notes: Chakradev is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Chakradev is recorded with the meaning “Lord of the Chakras”. Chakradev is a Sanskrit name meaning “Lord of the Chakras”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses. Note: this meaning has not been independently verified against a classical lexicon or primary source and is flagged for source verification.

in_sanskrit.name: चक्रदेव
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is the ruler of the chakras or wheels within the human body.

in_hindi.name: चक्रदेव
in_hindi.long_meaning: शरीर में व्यक्त हुए चक्रों का स्वामी है।

in_tamil.name: சக்கரதேவன்
in_tamil.long_meaning: மனித உடலில் வெளியிடப்பட்ட வளையுறுப்புகளின் அடிப்படையையும் தொடர்புடையவன்.

in_marathi.name: Chakradev
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Chakras
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chakradev हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chakradev is a powerful Hindu name derived from Sanskrit, referring to the Lord of the Chakras, or the energy centers in our body.
